notes: The side rail is there on every version now: Songs, Playlists and Albums, fixed at the right edge of the library, with the page you are on lit.
Playlists opens the playlist strip, Albums opens your albums and Songs opens All Songs - the same pages the strip above the list has, without scrolling back up to reach them.
The see-through amount in Tools sets that rail too, from solid to glyphs only, and the rail still holds its place while you move between the three pages.
